title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
summary: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Correcting these behavioral divergences remains difficult: offline data may miss the student's failure contexts, while its own rollouts may provide few correct responses in those contexts. We introduce …
description: low-bit quantization, LLM agents, quantization-aware distillation, full-precision teacher, student model
developer_name: Genming Cui, Xiangyu Li, Zixu Hao, Xin Ding, Yunxin Liu et al. (6 authors)

analysis.detail_brief: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Correcting these behavioral divergences remains difficult: offline data may miss the student's failure contexts, while its own rollouts may provide few correct responses in those contexts.
